calibration.measuredOn: 2026-10-10, sharp 0.35.5, seeded noise (6 samples); re-measured the same day on a second libvips build (8.18.7)
calibration.data: SIMULATED captures of one synthetic certificate with procedural photos. Not real phones, not real cards, not real forgeries.
calibration.buildVariance: Every number below is the WORST value seen across the two libvips builds, because resampling differs slightly between them and one build's figures are not portable: the largest re-capture photo tile was 8 on the first build and 10 on the second. The thresholds classify all 22 re-captures CONSISTENT and all 6 swaps REVIEW on both.
calibration.margins: regionFar 16 is the threshold that does the work: it sits 10 above the largest re-capture photo region (6) and 10 below the smallest swap (26), a gap of 20 with no overlap on either build. cellFar 12 has no such margin for a photo swap: the photo tile reaches 10 on an awkwardly angled re-capture and starts at 10 on a swap, so the 4x4 grid alone cannot separate the two. A swapped photo is caught by the photo REGION hash, not by the tile grid. The grid earns its place elsewhere, localising a pasted block of text, where every other tile stays at 0 across all 22 re-captures.
calibration.wholeFarNote: reported but never used to decide anything: the whole-page hash cannot see a photo swap (2 to 8, the same range as ordinary captures)
calibration.knownBlindSpots: A different person's card on the same template, and edits to printed text (date of birth, CGPA), are INVISIBLE to a perceptual hash (largest tile 12 and 0). Tier 3 cannot approve or reject on its own. That is why it is advisory.
calibration.mustRedo: Re-run on a sample of real captures and real forgeries before relying on these numbers.
calibration.regionStability: Measured per region when a document is issued: the largest Hamming distance of the region's own hash under JPEG q60, a half-size JPEG q70 copy and a 1px blur. Textured (procedural) photos: 0 to 6 over 12 photos. Flat placeholder portraits with hard edges: 28 and 30. regionStableMax 12 sits 6 above the first and 16 below the second. A region above it is reported as unreliable and never judged (its re-capture distances reach 30, its swap distances start at 16, so no regionFar can separate them).
